reasons: § 2.1 is squarely in walk-away territory under MINCOMMIT: a three-year USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay expressly 'without reduction or termination rights', failing the fallback (12-month, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up) on every material term, so a deviation classification and redline are warranted.

The redline implements the permitted 'delete' branch of the redline guidance, replacing the commitment with payment for usage/ordered Services only; the high changed-character ratio is expected for a clause the rule directs us to delete or replace wholesale and does not indicate over-editing.

The comment is accurate, correctly cites the playbook position, notes the internal consistency with § 12.3 (Vendor's acknowledgement of no minimum-volume commitment), and offers the 12-month/30-day-reduction true-up fallback, matching the required tone and prefix.
No double-flagging concern: the finding addresses the commitment itself, not the fee-transparency point in § 7.1, which is only referenced as supporting context.
